verdict.rationale: Dagster provides asset checks that can 'check if an asset's data needs refreshing' (freshness checks), asset check results visible in the UI with severity levels, and Dagster+ alerts to notify on critical events like missed schedules/failed checks, plus schedules/sensors/declarative automation to detect cadence misses. missing for 10: no explicit hands-on/independent confirmation of freshness-alert workflows in production, and no dedicated 'freshness SLA' dashboard example beyond docs claims.
